# Medical News Today

> > A comprehensive medical information platform providing science-backed resources on diseases, conditions, treatments, and wellness across all major health categories.

Medical News Today is a leading health information resource offering in-depth guides, news, and educational content on medical conditions, treatments, and wellness topics. The site covers everything from chronic diseases and mental health to fitness and environmental health, with content organized by condition and health topic.

## Key Topics

- COVID-19
- Cancer
- Cardiovascular Health
- Diabetes
- Alzheimer's & Dementia
- Anxiety
- HIV & AIDS
- Asthma & Allergies
- Breast Cancer
- Mental Health
- Exercise & Fitness
- Health Conditions
- Medical Information
- Disease Management
- Wellness Resources

## Major Health Conditions & Diseases

- [Cancer: Resources on diagnosis, treatment, and more](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/cancer): Cancer hub with news, types, symptoms, diagnosis, stages, and treatment info
- [Breast cancer: Resources on symptoms, treatment, and more](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/breast-cancer): Comprehensive breast cancer guide covering risks, symptoms, diagnosis, treatment
- [Diabetes](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/diabetes): In-depth diabetes resources covering type 1, type 2, gestational, management
- [Cardiovascular health: Heart-healthy, science-backed resources](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/cardiovascular-health): Science-backed heart health resources on disease, blood pressure, stroke, diet
- [HIV and AIDS](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/hiv-and-aids): Research-backed HIV and AIDS information on symptoms, treatments, lifestyle
- [Leukemia: Resources on symptoms, diagnosis, and treatment](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/leukemia): Leukemia resource covering ALL, AML, CLL, CML symptoms, diagnosis, treatment

## Neurological & Mental Health

- [Dementia: Resources on Alzheimer's and other dementias](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/alzheimers-and-dementia): Science-backed guide to Alzheimer's disease and dementia symptoms, management, care
- [Anxiety: Resources on symptoms, treatment, and more](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/anxiety): Comprehensive anxiety resource covering symptoms, causes, treatment options
- [Headache and migraine: Resources backed by science](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/headache-and-migraine): Evidence-backed migraine and headache prevention, causes, and treatment guide

## Respiratory, Skin & Sensory Health

- [COVID-19 (coronavirus): Latest news and developments](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/coronavirus): Latest COVID-19 news, symptoms, protection, and expert health advice
- [Asthma & allergies: Resources on management & treatment](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/asthma-and-allergies): Science-backed resources on asthma and allergy management and treatment
- [Atopic dermatitis overview and health information resource guide](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/program/investigating-atopic-dermatitis): Atopic dermatitis overview and health information resource guide
- [Eye health: Resources for healthy vision](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/eye-health): Eye health resources on vision conditions, symptoms, treatments, supplements

## Wellness & Lifestyle

- [Exercise & fitness: In-depth resources for health and well-being](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/exercise-and-fitness): Science-backed exercise, fitness, weight management, and health resources
- [Environment and sustainability: Caring for our health and our planet](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/environment-and-sustainability): Environmental health impacts and sustainable wellness product resources

## Medical Reference & Education

- [Human biology: Insights into the human body](https://www.medicalnewstoday.com/human-biology): In-depth human body systems: nervous, cardiovascular, immune system reference
